authoritative_evidence.text: Alert: cross-tenant PATCH by tenant-5-alpha targeting tenant-5-bravo/order-5.

judge_input.report_text: Investigation: tenant-5-alpha issued a PATCH to tenant-5-bravo/order-5. The gateway records status 200, state_changed=true, and is_admin=true [log-1]. The policy permits cross-tenant writes only for administrators [policy-1]. Conclusion: The write was authorized administration, not an unauthorized effect. These records do not establish data exfiltration.
